patch_description: Redesigns the pipeline around a three-stage streaming architecture: (1) an adaptive 1D Kalman filter (state = [level, slope]) whose process noise auto-tunes to local volatility, (2) a polynomial (Savitzky-Golay-style) trend refinement stage that preserves dynamics with low phase lag, and (3) a trend-guard / hysteresis stage that suppresses spurious slope reversals (false reversals) by requiring a slope change to exceed an adaptive threshold. The whole filter is vectorized and computes outputs in one pass, keeping efficiency high while dramatically reducing slope changes, false reversals, lag error, and average error compared to a moving average. Public API (process_signal, run_signal_processing, generate_test_signal) and output formats are unchanged; only the internal filtering is replaced with the modular pipeline.
